newsitem.title: USA: Strouds sees further earnings pressure.
newsitem.headline: Strouds sees further earnings pressure.

text.p: Strouds Inc, a retailer of household textile products, on Monday said it expected strong competition and high advertising costs to put pressure on its earnings through the rest of fiscal 1997.
Earlier, Strouds reported a net loss of $0.18 a share for its third quarter ended November 30 compared with a profit of $0.08 in the year-earlier period.
"We continue to expect downward pressure on earnings for the remainder of this year...resulting in a net loss for this fiscal year," Wayne Selness, chief executive, said in a statement.
The company has substantially boosted advertising in the U.S. Midwest to increase awareness of its stores. Meanwhile, it has faced stepped-up competition in California stores.
Comparable-store sales for the first nine months of fiscal 1997 rose 1.3 percent from same-store sales a year earlier.
